slides.title: The failure:
slides.text:
The failure:
statelessness

A customer returns in a new chat, and the agent asks who they are again.
Restart mid-conversation: context is gone.
Identical sessions have no bridge.
This is an architectural failure; another business tool cannot fix it.

Ontology-driven extraction

Module 3

ontology/acme_cloud.yaml declares entity types, typed relationships, aliases and constraints.

Entity descriptions become annotation guidelines in the LLM extraction prompt, including negative cases.

Relations outside the ontology are dropped at ingest.

One YAML document drives both extraction and validation.

slides.title: The hybrid pipeline
slides.text:
The hybrid pipeline

Module 3

Entity spans, types and typed relations.

The LLM supplies structure, not invented attributes.

Hydration supplies email, plan and signup date.

Every business fact comes from the system of record.

Async enrichment adds public knowledge about real third parties, such as Stripe.

LLM → structure

SQLite → facts

Wikipedia → knowledge

Structure from the LLM. Facts from grounded sources.

slides.title: Reasoning
slides.text:
Reasoning
memory

Tasks, steps, tool calls and outcomes capture the agent’s own execution.
record_agent_trace consumes a PydanticAI AgentRunResult; record every run.
Retrieve similar past traces to prime familiar tasks.
Failures are first-class memory: a rejected refund teaches too.
